purpose: Every reason in round-2/tree.json (the v0.2.0 full run on its own 8/10 rating) receives exactly one disposition from this catalog, recorded in ledger.json.
rules: Precedence: an IMP code wins over an R code, and an R code wins over an X code. A reason naming an external fact that a v0.3.0 change mitigates gets that IMP code.
X-HIST and X-ENV notes cite the IMP or R code that handles any actionable part, when one exists.
X-FALSE covers premises untrue of v0.2.0 as well as causal links that do not hold.
Ongoing constraints of a solo, unfunded project are X-ENV when nothing in the plugin can change them.
facts: The v0.2.0 full run completed on 2026-09-13: 26 agents, 3,905 of 3,905 reasons, 0 hygiene flags at similarity 0.6, 0 failures in 19 logged checks, 102 stated assumptions, 595,250 bytes (about 148.8k tokens, 38 per reason).
A machine restart stopped wave 1. The root and 7 branch fragments had been written; plan skipped them and 18 branches were re-dispatched 5 at a time; nothing got stuck.

Agent-reported totals: root 44.1k tokens; branches 57.5k-72.5k (mean 63.1k) over 10-22 turns, with 15.1k-21.7k output tokens and 2 Reads each. Cumulative context across a branch's turns was 0.40M-0.97M, mostly cache reads.
Branch prompt files were about 6.8 KB each and the root prompt 2.9 KB, so prompt text is roughly 1.7k of a branch's 63k tokens.
Stemmed word overlap between reasons in different level-1 branches finds 14 pairs at 0.45 or more in this tree (for example 1.5.5.4.1 and 2.4.4.4.2); the v0.2.0 check flagged none.
The run was orchestrated by hand from the session with the cached 0.2.0 script; neither this run nor any earlier one executed SKILL.md through /five-whys, and the eval has never run.
v0.2.0 already has show --sample, status, check-log.jsonl, attempt tracking, prompt files and subprocess-driven CLI tests.
`claude --plugin-dir <path>` loads a plugin from a directory for one session, so an unpublished checkout can be exercised before release.
Round 2 was classified by one session that read the whole tree, without subagents, at the user's request.

improvements.title: Remeasured cost
improvements.detail: Estimate constants and the README cost table come from the v0.2.0 full run (per-agent totals, 38 output tokens per reason); the basis names the version, model and what the totals count.

improvements.title: Version stamps
improvements.detail: run.json and the five-whys.json header record plugin_version read from plugin.json; init and status print it; a MEASURED constant labels the estimate and a docs test ties it to the README.

improvements.title: Changelog with evidence
improvements.detail: CHANGELOG.md holds a dated entry per version with its verification evidence; RELEASING.md points evidence there; a docs test requires an entry for the manifest version.

improvements.title: Release gates by change kind
improvements.detail: RELEASING.md: prompt, agent, dispatch or estimate changes need a model-invoked run through /five-whys (checkout loaded with --plugin-dir) or the eval; figures name their version; review a ledger sample; check option count.

improvements.title: Test the checkout before publishing
improvements.detail: README and RELEASING.md document `claude --plugin-dir .` so unpublished SKILL.md and agent text run in a real session before the marketplace entry changes.

improvements.title: Invocation parsed in code
improvements.detail: A parse subcommand reads the raw $ARGUMENTS on stdin and returns the problem, init flags, --yes, --resume and errors for unknown options, honoring a -- separator; SKILL.md Step 1 uses it.

improvements.title: Confirmation decided in code
improvements.detail: init returns confirm: true when agents exceed CONFIRM_AGENTS; SKILL.md obeys the flag; a docs test ties the constant to the prose.

improvements.title: Settings recorded and shown
improvements.detail: run.json stores the options given to init and the plugin version; index.md opens with the shape, model, wave size and version that produced the tree.

improvements.title: Per-tier model flags removed
improvements.detail: --root-model and --branch-model go: unmeasured, unreachable from /five-whys, and they multiplied configurations. plan still honors tier fields in older run.json files.

improvements.title: Options with stated purpose and a count
improvements.detail: The README options table says why each option exists; a docs test pins the number of skill options so additions and removals are deliberate.

improvements.title: Later waves see finished branches
improvements.detail: Branch prompts list the first-level reasons of branch fragments that already validate, beside the root's reasons, so staged waves reduce cross-branch repeats.

improvements.title: Smaller default waves
improvements.detail: max_parallel defaults to 5 instead of filling the 20-subagent cap, pairing with IMP-42 and lighter machine load; --max-parallel 20 remains for speed.

improvements.title: Orchestration replay test
improvements.detail: A unit test walks SKILL.md's loop with fake agents: parse, init, plan --record, fragments, check, status, assemble; plus a failing agent reaching stuck and assemble --partial.

improvements.title: Stemmed and cross-branch hygiene
improvements.detail: Tokens strip common suffixes; pairs in different level-1 branches at 0.45 or more are listed as cross_branch leads; flags carry both texts; filters and cutoffs appear in hygiene.json.

improvements.title: Check sees the real ancestors
improvements.detail: For a branch fragment inside a run, check loads the root's chain for that node so restatement warnings compare against real ancestors and the root's reasons.

improvements.title: Paraphrase pairs from a real tree
improvements.detail: tests/fixtures/pairs.json holds labeled convergent and distinct pairs from the v0.2.0 tree; a test records how many the heuristic catches and fails if detection regresses.

improvements.title: Read plan sized by bytes
improvements.detail: assemble lists Read offsets in index.md from line byte sizes under a budget, replacing the fixed 400-line rule in SKILL.md and README.

improvements.title: Agent guidance beyond software problems
improvements.detail: why-expander.md gains a non-software example, a rule for problems with nothing to read, leaves that keep a concrete tie to their chain, and assumptions for ungrounded reasons.

improvements.title: Thin-problem eval case
improvements.detail: A second eval case runs a one-line non-software problem through --smoke --yes; RELEASING.md cites graders/criteria.md instead of paraphrasing it.

improvements.title: Auditable ledger tooling
improvements.detail: ledger.py rounds: rule fragments with inheritance recorded as via, sample with ancestors and code detail, summary of X notes citing codes; catalog precedence rules.

improvements.title: Hygiene in its own module
improvements.detail: Similarity code moves to scripts/hygiene.py beside fivewhys.py, keeping one entry point for SKILL.md and agents while the largest self-contained concern gets its own file.

improvements.title: Round-2 record
improvements.detail: docs/self-improvement holds round 1 and round 2 side by side, with measured facts, a recorded sample audit and a review of the plugin made outside the tree.

dispositions.title: Declined: plugin-side ranking, synthesis, pruning or root-cause selection
dispositions.detail: Analysis stays with the user. Mechanical leads such as IMP-45 cross-branch pairs are the allowed aid.

dispositions.title: Declined: embeddings, third-party packages, API keys or network calls
dispositions.detail: Would break the zero-dependency offline install and send problem text off the machine.

dispositions.title: Declined: model judge inside the blocking fix loop
dispositions.detail: Flaky verdicts loop repair cycles and multiply cost.

dispositions.title: Declined: incomplete trees
dispositions.detail: Early stopping, variable breadth, not-applicable slots or pruning break the complete-tree requirement.

dispositions.title: Out of scope: social or organizational remedies
dispositions.detail: Recruiting reviewers or testers, announcements, curated-marketplace submission, paying for review. Not plugin changes.

dispositions.title: Declined: token usage relayed through the orchestrator
dispositions.detail: Usage reaches only the model's tool results; copying numbers through prose is unreliable. Measure from subagent logs per release instead (IMP-35).

dispositions.title: Declined: prompt-length term in the estimate
dispositions.detail: Measured prompts are about 1.7k of 63k tokens per branch; generation and evidence reading dominate (IMP-32 remeasures those).

dispositions.title: Declined: live evals, secrets or model runs in CI
dispositions.detail: Paid on every push, secrets exposed to Bash-capable agents, unavailable to forks, nondeterministic. Evals run locally per RELEASING.md.

dispositions.title: Declined: model-based convergence or quality review inside the plugin
dispositions.detail: Nondeterministic, costs a second full read and crosses into analysis. IMP-45 lists mechanical cross-branch leads instead.

dispositions.title: Declined: cross-links or graph structure in the tree schema
dispositions.detail: The deliverable is a complete strict tree; relationships stay in hygiene.json.

dispositions.title: Declined: persistent settings files or environment defaults
dispositions.detail: Shape and model are per-problem choices; a stale stored default could silently launch a costly run. Flags stay explicit and are recorded (IMP-39).

dispositions.title: Declined: telemetry, phoning home or cross-run collection
dispositions.detail: Problem statements can be confidential and there is no backend; run.json records settings locally (IMP-39).

dispositions.title: Deferred: studies needing many paid runs
dispositions.detail: Model-tier quality, same-model variance, multi-domain benchmarks, grader reliability and large labeled corpora. Recorded as known limitations.

dispositions.title: Declined: a headless runner owning the dispatch loop
dispositions.detail: claude -p subprocesses would spawn separate sessions, lose inline progress and need their own auth; the loop stays with the orchestrating model, helped by IMP-37, IMP-38 and IMP-44.

dispositions.title: Declined: developer tooling dependencies in CI
dispositions.detail: Linters, coverage and complexity tools add installs to a stdlib project; structure is handled by IMP-52 and review.

dispositions.title: Declined: fragment provenance markers
dispositions.detail: Any session can write identical bytes, so a marker proves nothing; authorship is checked in transcripts by the eval grader.

dispositions.title: Declined: fault injection or tunable attempt limits for rehearsal
dispositions.detail: IMP-44 drives the stuck and partial paths deterministically with fake agents, without new options.

dispositions.title: Already resolved
dispositions.detail: The note says what resolved it, usually a fact above or an existing v0.2.0 feature.

dispositions.title: Premise untrue or causal link does not hold
dispositions.detail: The note names the contradicting fact.

dispositions.title: Outside the plugin's control
dispositions.detail: Platform, model, ecosystem or the project's standing circumstances. Cite a mitigating code when one exists.

dispositions.title: Past motivation or process, nothing further to change
dispositions.detail: Explains how v0.2.0 came to be. Cite the code that handles any actionable part.
